method.statistic: Median of independent in-process batches targeted at a minimum duration after one warm-up batch. Each runtime repeatedly invokes the same deterministic benchmark function; NAIDE setup and parsing are excluded from steady-state timing. Startup includes process launch, initialization, and one correctness execution.
method.memory: OS process high-water RSS. Node/Bun use process.resourceUsage(); CPython uses GetProcessMemoryInfo on Windows or getrusage elsewhere.
method.limitations: Single host and fixed local runtime versions. Workloads measure only their named constructs and do not establish general language or application performance.
method.executionPath: The NaideVM benchmark function is obtained once from the VM global environment and invoked directly, matching Node and CPython function-call measurements; setup and parsing are excluded from steady-state timing. The interpreter tier, direct Windows x64 machine-code tier, and hotness-tiered x64 machine-code tier are measured separately when the native bridge is available. Native tier diagnostics are enabled and included in each report.

acceptance.requirement: Every workload must exceed Node.js/V8 independently for a tier to pass; no aggregate-only pass. CPython results remain descriptive.
